name: 94706 · Albany, CA
findings: ZIP 94706 (Albany) has 83 nonprofit organizations. 43 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 34 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 94706 (Albany) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 94706 (Albany) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).
